vladilena_milize.identityProse: Vladilena Milizé (Lena) from 86 -Eighty Six-, the valiant commander known as Bloody Reina, an aristocratic beauty with long silky silver-white hair and two antenna-like ahoge strands, expressive silver-grey eyes, wearing the blue San Magnolia Republic military uniform with a tactical Para-RAID headset and unwavering resolve

asuna_yuuki.identityProse: Asuna Yuuki from Sword Art Online, the famed Lightning Flash and sub-leader of the Knights of the Blood, a beautiful warrior with waist-length chestnut-honey hair styled with a half-up side braid, warm hazel-amber eyes, an earnest confident smile, and an athletic yet feminine hourglass figure

violet_evergarden.identityProse: Violet Evergarden from Violet Evergarden, an ethereal and pristine former soldier turned Auto Memories Doll, with mid-back braided golden-blonde hair tied with red ribbons, luminous azure-blue eyes, articulated silver prosthetic mechanical hands, and a doll-like porcelain face brimming with tender emotion
